coordinateSystem: ICRS, barycentric direction; Julian epoch 2017.5 TCB
magnitudeSystem: Gaia G, Vega; not a measured colour or spectral type
selection: All published FPR sources within 8 arcmin of (201.697,-47.480) deg, G <= 19; no additional membership or quality cut. Complete query result, not a complete stellar census.
distanceInterpretation: Display at the common omega Cen distance is a projection assumption; individual source membership and line-of-sight distance remain unverified.
deduplication: ESA catalogue documentation states sources already present in the nominal Gaia catalogue were removed from this SIF add-on catalogue. Within the downloaded result, all exact decimal source IDs are unique. No claim of a new independent astrophysical crossmatch is made.
qualityInterpretation: Formal position errors, G flux S/N, matched_transits, n_scans and astrometric solution flags were retained and summarised. These are measurement quality indicators, not membership probabilities. FPR contains no meaningful colour information.
acknowledgement: This work has made use of data from the European Space Agency (ESA) mission Gaia (https://www.cosmos.esa.int/gaia), processed by the Gaia Data Processing and Analysis Consortium (DPAC, https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/gaia/dpac/consortium). Funding for the DPAC has been provided by national institutions, in particular the institutions participating in the Gaia Multilateral Agreement.

queries.adql:
SELECT source_id,ra,dec,ref_epoch,phot_g_mean_mag,ra_error,dec_error,phot_g_mean_flux_over_error,n_scans,matched_transits,astrometric_params_solved,pmra,pmdec,pmra_error,pmdec_error
FROM gaiafpr.crowded_field_source
WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',201.697,-47.480,0.065))
AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 19
ORDER BY source_id

SELECT source_id,ra,dec,ref_epoch,phot_g_mean_mag,ra_error,dec_error,phot_g_mean_flux_over_error,n_scans,matched_transits,astrometric_params_solved,pmra,pmdec,pmra_error,pmdec_error
FROM gaiafpr.crowded_field_source
WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',201.697,-47.480,8/60.0))
AND 0=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',201.697,-47.480,0.065))
AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 19
ORDER BY source_id
